title: Type a number into any Effects slider, not just drag it
goal: Every setting in the Effects list is a slider you drag: a shadow blur, a border width, a border offset, a glow size. There is nowhere to type an exact number, so a border offset of exactly 12 is a matter of nudging the knob until the readout says 12. Let the readout beside each slider be typed into, the way X and Y in Position and Size already are.
notes: Found while adding the border Offset row on 2026-09-09: the task asked for it typed and dragged like its Width, and Width turned out not to be typeable either. LayerStyleSlider (Sources/Photonz/InspectorControls.swift line 49) draws the readout as a Text with .panelReadout; making it editable there fixes every Effects row at once, and the Appearance sliders that use the same view.
acceptance: Clicking the number beside any Effects slider lets you type a new one and press return
The number typed is clamped to the same range the slider covers, and a nonsense entry leaves the old number alone
Typing a number records one undo step, the same as dragging the slider does
Every effect kind is covered: shadow, border, glow and blur
The sliders in Appearance take a typed number too: Thickness, Opacity and an arrow's Head Size

log.note: Also wanted in Appearance, not just Effects: a path drawn with the Pen now has a Thickness slider there (2026-09-14) and on a 24 pixel icon frame the useful weights are 1, 2 and 3 while the slider covers 1 to 40, so the whole icon range is the first few pixels of travel and picking 2 rather than 3 is a fight. Same for Opacity and an arrow's Head Size. Added an acceptance item for it.

DESIGN REVIEW 2026-09-15: do not write a fourth number box for this. The app already has three, each hand-rolled and each knowing something the others do not (GeometryInspector.swift:291, ArrangementInspector.swift:836, and MotionListInspector.swift:583 added today). The extraction is filed as one-number-box-everywhere-a-number-is-typed-into and this task is its fourth customer: an Effects slider that can be typed into should be that box, so it inherits what happens when a layer refuses part of the number and what the box says when several picked layers disagree, rather than rediscovering both.

Do NOT write a fourth number box for this. The one box landed on 2026-09-16: Sources/Photonz/PanelNumberField.swift, on top of NumberBox in PhotonzCore (tested, Tests/PhotonzCoreTests/NumberBoxTests.swift). Geometry, Arrangement, the knobs on a copy, the four sides popout, the motion rows and the timing strip are all this one control now.

What you pass it for an Effects slider:
  showing:      NumberBox.showing(value, standingIn: isMixed ? MixedValue.text : "")
  label:        the slider's own name (it becomes the placeholder AND the accessibility label, so a walk's focus step finds it by name)
  suffix:       the unit mark, where the number means nothing without one
  floor/ceiling: the ends of the slider's range. The box holds the number inside them BEFORE it reaches the model, so a typed 140 on a 0-100 strength shows 100 rather than 140 over a slider at the top
  wholeNumbers: true for the strengths that count in whole numbers
  spell:        how this panel writes a number, if it is not whole points
  land:         set it, and hand back what it really became (nil where it took what it was given)

You get for free, decided once: Return and Tab land it, Escape puts it back, both hand the keyboard to the picture; clicking in selects the whole number; up and down step by 1 and Shift by 10 from the number ON SCREEN; the word Mixed as the box's own text at the dock strength (MixedLook); landing nothing again when the number is already there, so no undo step is spent on a change nobody can see; and emptying the box is a property you set (clear:) rather than something to re-decide.
